pages.raw_title: Full-Service Site Access & Project Solutions | NPK
pages.raw_meta: NPK is your trusted partner in site access solutions, offering sustainable composite matting and full-service support for projects across industries.
raw_blocks: Proceed with Confidence with NPK

Preparing for a tough project in utilities, oil and gas, pipeline or other infrastructure construction? At NPK, we tackle your challenges head-on. We are the only site access solutions partner to manufacture and rent industry-leading sustainable composite matting, along with a full suite of services including planning, logistics, and remediation – so you can protect your people, the environment, and your bottom line.
Comprehensive Site Access Solutions You Can Trust
You bring the vision – we bring the expertise.
Access Roads & Work Pads
We provide you with a variety of temporary site access solutions tailor-made to meet your needs – for rental or purchase.
We have the people, equipment, and know-how to deliver the solutions your project requires – no matter how complex.
Project Planning & Site Evaluation
We’ll partner with you, visiting your site and crafting a comprehensive strategy that puts safety and cost-effectiveness at the top of the list.
Success starts with thorough site prep. Count on us for every detail, minimizing risks and setting the stage for smooth, on-time, and on-budget operations.
We’ll help keep your project on track by navigating the complexities of environmental and regulatory requirements, ensuring your site access is compliant.
Our comprehensive restoration services bring ecological balance, preserve biodiversity, and support sustainable land management.
Good for Your Business, Good for the Earth
Keep your people safe in unpredictable conditions – thanks to our experienced teams and engineered DURA-BASE® matting.
Our environmental planning services and site access solutions preserve the land – for both today and tomorrow.
Keep projects running smoothly and safeguard your assets with our reliable service, fleet scale, and access management.
“We continually strive to lead the industry with innovative solutions and next generation technologies that work in harmony with the environment and leave a positive impression on our communities.”
DURA-BASE ® : Where Innovation Meets Durability

Experience the game-changing benefits of DURA-BASE®, the leading heavy-duty composite matting solution for the toughest environments. As part of our full-service offering, DURA-BASE® provides the durable, reliable support you need for safe and efficient site access, no matter the project.
DURA-BASE® Successfully Tested in World-First Australian Defense Trial
NPK International Appoints New Member to the Board of Directors
NPK Access Solutions Builds on Nearly 30 Years in Carencro, LA with $40 Million Investment

raw_blocks: Meet NPK: your go-to ally for site access solutions.

NPK is the only site access solutions partner to manufacture and rent industry-leading sustainable composite matting , along with a full suite of services including planning, logistics, and remediation — so you can protect your people, the environment, and your bottom line.

At NPK, our values, safety, integrity, accountability, respect, and excellence are more than words—they are non-negotiable fundamentals that define what is important to us. They are the foundation for our purpose.

Our purpose encapsulates how our values work together to drive our decision-making, actions, and behaviors. They help us create meaningful relationships with each other, our clients, and partners. Every day, we strive to live these values and fulfill our purpose, building a culture that reflects who we are and where we’re headed.
Different voices make us stronger together.
Unwavering in our quality and service.
Energy and excitement is our fuel.
Any moment is a chance to shine.
Agility is the key to opportunity.
Safety and quality are at the heart of everything we do.
Our greatest asset is our people.
We’re always looking for new talent to join our team.
